results.requirement: The app is one self-contained HTML file: apart from exchange-rate lookups it makes no network requests, and needs no CSS/JS/font files.
No JavaScript or console errors occur on any page or tab (phone and laptop size).
The app loads and its buttons work with the network completely offline.
The Barlow Condensed font is embedded in the file (works offline, nothing fetched from Google).
Apple/mobile support: viewport meta with safe-area, apple-mobile-web-app meta tags and theme colour are present.
Dark theme: very dark page background and light text.
No bold fonts: no visible element uses a font weight above 500, on any page.
Buttons use drawn icons or text, never emoji (habit icon picker excluded).
Page switcher lists Habits, Planner, Budget and Journal, and the chosen page is remembered after reload.
Footer carries a very small, subtle disclaimer (no responsibility, no data collected, free to use) and "v0.2" at the bottom right.
If browser storage is blocked the app still loads and works in memory without errors.
Add button (+) is available on Habits, Planner and Budget and hidden on Journal; each opens the right sheet.
Works the same when the file is opened directly from disk (file://) and when hosted over http(s) as on GitHub Pages.
Auto-save: every change is written to browser storage as one JSON document (habits, plan, journal, budget, plans, settings).
Reloading restores habits, planner, journal, budget and payment plans from storage.
Export file: Data menu downloads a .json file containing all data.
Import file: choosing a valid export replaces the current data.
Import rejects an invalid file with a message and leaves existing data untouched.
Budget-only export produces a CSV (with header and one row per entry); the other data is not included.
Settings persist across reloads: habit view, sort order, week start day, exchange-rate currencies, Pomodoro lengths, budget period.
No sideways page scroll on any page or tab at 320 px wide.
No sideways page scroll on any page or tab at 360 px wide.
No sideways page scroll on any page or tab at 390 px wide.
No sideways page scroll on any page or tab at 430 px wide.
No sideways page scroll on any page or tab at 768 px wide.
No sideways page scroll on any page or tab at 1024 px wide.
No sideways page scroll on any page or tab at 1280 px wide.
No sideways page scroll on any page or tab at 1920 px wide.
Live resizing: shrinking from laptop to phone width and back re-flows the layout with no sideways scroll and no reload.
Pomodoro timer stays on a single row from 320 px upward; the three exchange rates stay on one line from 360 px upward.
Budget summary shows income, expense, savings and left in a single row at every width from 320 px.
Habit year view fits without side scrolling on phones.
Weekly planner shows 3 days by default on phones and 7 on laptops, and the user can change the count.
Sheets/dialogs: bottom sheet on phones, centred dialog on laptops; always fully inside the viewport and scrollable.
Touch-friendly: main tap targets (tabs, tick buttons, toolbar buttons, + button) are at least 28 px high; form fields use 16 px text so iOS does not zoom.
The + button stays inside the viewport at every width and the page keeps room below the content so it never hides the footer text.
Content is centred and capped to a readable maximum width on very wide screens.
Habit cards use a multi-column grid on laptops and a single column on phones.
Habit views are tabs along the top in the order List (default), Week, Month, Day, Year, Statistics.
Add a build habit with name, tags, icon and colour; it appears in the list and the header counts it.
Ticking a habit today updates the header ("1 of 1 done"), the streak text and storage; ticking again undoes it.
Quit habits: quit date, goal days and money saved per day; days since the quit date count as clean; tapping today logs a slip and restarts the streak.
Tapping a habit name opens it for editing; Delete (after confirming) removes it.
Tags: tag chips filter the list; typing in the tag field suggests existing tags.
Sort button offers several orders and reorders the list (e.g. by name).
Week, Month and Day views each show their own visualisation and the previous/next arrows change the period.
Year view shows 12 month rows with one cell per day for every habit.
Statistics tab shows overview tiles and per-habit benchmark metrics.
Streak maths: a habit ticked on the last 5 consecutive days (incl. today) has a streak of 5; a gap resets it.
Planner tabs: Day, Rolling, Week, Goals, Statistics, in that order.
Add a one-off task and complete it: it shows in the day list, the header reads "x of y tasks done today", and ticking updates it.
Recurring tasks: repeat Once / Daily / chosen weekdays / Monthly; the weekday picker defaults to the current weekday and tasks only occur on the chosen days.
Monthly repeat occurs on the same date each month.
Subtasks can be added and ticked independently of the parent task.
Goals: add a goal with start and target dates; link a task to it; the Goals tab lists it with a year timeline.
Filter and sort: show all / hide recurring / recurring only, tag chips, and several sort orders.
Week tab shows a fixed week from a chosen start day (default Monday) and the choice is remembered.
Rolling view starts with today as the left-most day and loads further weeks when scrolling sideways.
Weekdays and weekends have two different dark shades on every planner view (day strip, rolling, week) with a repeating 5+2 pattern.
Timed tasks appear in the week/rolling grid at their hour as coloured bubbles.
Planner statistics tab renders completion figures.
Tags in the planner: tag chips filter the calendar, and the tag field offers suggestions from all pages.
Budget layout: summary tiles above the period tabs; tabs are Week, Month, Year (default Month).
Each period has its own visualisation (week, month, year charts differ) and the summary figures follow the period.
Summary maths: income, expense, savings and left are correct for a known set of entries.
Summary tiles are not rebuilt or animated when a filter / same tab is chosen, never animate on period change, and do update when an entry is added.
Entries: amount, category with colour, note, tags, date; the entry shows in the list and the header shows "Spent £x this month".
Generic categories with distinct colours include Rent, Salary, Savings, Investments, Groceries, Bills, Transport etc., grouped into income / savings / expense.
Default currency is GBP; other currencies (incl. AED) are converted using the live rate, and the rate used is stored with the entry.
Repeat options: Once, Weekly, Selected days, Every 4 weeks, Monthly, Yearly (+ Until date).
Selected days: choose any combination of weekdays (e.g. Tue + Thu); occurrences fall only on those days, starting from the entry date.
Selected days with nothing chosen is refused; edits keep the chosen days.
Recurrence rules: weekly = every 7 days, every 4 weeks = 28 days, monthly keeps the date (clamped to month end), yearly keeps the date; "until" stops it.
Payment plan: full amount, APR, monthly payment and day; the schedule is generated until paid off; maths matches the standard amortisation formula.
Extra (early) payments can be added to a plan and shorten it.
Payment plans appear under "Recurring and payment plans" with progress and next payment.
Filter popover: Show (all/spent/income/saved), Include (all/recurring/one-off), Break down by (category/tag); each changes the numbers shown.
Breakdown shows every category / tag with its total amount and percentage of the whole.
Tags on budget entries: chips filter the entries; the tag field suggests tags used anywhere in the app.
Budget export button (CSV) is on the budget page.
Journal entry: day navigation, five mood buttons, grateful-for, notes; saved automatically; word count and entries list update.
Journal search filters the entries list; tiles show entries, streak, words and average mood.
Hourly mood is a single scrollable row of 24 hour slots; today's current hour is the second-from-last visible slot; future hours are disabled.
Arrow buttons beside the hour row scroll it; they disable at the ends.
Emotion wheel: 6 core emotions in the centre ring, 18 specific emotions in the outer ring, plus 2 refinements shown as chips once one is chosen.
Saving an hour stores core/secondary/tertiary/note under that date and hour; the slot shows its colour and emotion name.
Clear removes an hour; a day with nothing left is removed from storage.
Previous/next hour arrows inside the wheel sheet auto-save the chosen emotion and move on; Next is disabled beyond the current hour today.
Mood curve: a chart with one dot per logged hour, a legend of the emotions used and a one-line summary (check-ins, average feeling, most frequent).
Wheel accessibility: segments are focusable buttons with labels, selectable with Enter/Space; text on every segment has readable contrast.
Hourly moods are included in the export, show in the entries list ("n mood check-ins") and count as a journal entry.
Weight: enter today's weight (decimals allowed); it is saved automatically in kg under the date, shows the change since the previous logged weight, and counts as a journal entry.
Weight unit kg / lb: switching converts what is shown, storage stays in kg, and the choice is remembered (also in the exported settings).
Weight trend chart: one dot per logged day with a line between them, axis labels and hover values; 30 / 90 day switch changes the window.

Calories: choose a meal (Breakfast / Lunch / Dinner / Snack), enter kcal and an optional description, Add; the total, remaining amount and progress bar update; entries can be removed; invalid amounts are refused.
Calorie goal: default 2,000, editable (500-20,000) and remembered; going over the goal says so and turns the bar and chart bar amber.
Calories chart: last 14 days as bars against a dashed goal line, with legend (within / over goal), hover values and a 7-day average that matches the data.
Weight and calories appear in the journal entries list, are exported / imported with the data, and count towards the journal streak.
Weight and calories panels fit at 320 px (no sideways scroll), sit side by side on laptops, and their fields use 16 px text so iOS does not zoom.
Clock: shows the current time and date, seconds tick, AM/PM is shown separately, and the date line has no stray separators.
Clock and Pomodoro sit in the same place on every page and are not rebuilt when switching pages.
Pomodoro: default 25:00 focus / 5:00 break; start counts down, pause holds, reset restores, switching mode sets the other length.
Pomodoro keeps running while switching between pages, and the browser tab title shows the countdown.
Pomodoro lengths are adjustable 1 to 60 minutes (never above 60) and are remembered.
Completing a focus session beeps (no error), counts "n sessions today" and switches to break.
Live exchange rates: three currencies are shown under the timer with an "updated" time when the source answers.
Exchange rates fall back to the next source if the first fails.
When every source fails the row says "offline · tap to retry", keeps the last known rates, and tapping retries.
Exchange-rate currencies are chosen from three drop-downs (AED included), shown immediately and remembered.
AED has a built-in peg (3.6725 per USD) when a source does not list it.
Header sub-title is live per page: habits done, tasks done, spent this month, journal written.
Spent-this-month in the header equals the sum of this month's expense entries (including recurring occurrences).
Journal tiles (entries, streak, words, average mood) are derived from stored entries.
Day roll-over: when midnight passes the app re-renders so "today" moves on without a reload.
Derived habit figures (streaks, completion, statistics) update immediately after ticking a habit.
